notes: Kama usasishaji unaonekana kutokamilika mara kwa mara: baada ya kubonyeza Sasisha, subiri skrini nyingine ifunguke kisha bonyeza Install na Open humo -- usirudi nyuma kabla ya kumaliza. / If the update keeps showing as not finished: after tapping Update, wait for a second screen to open and tap Install then Open there -- don't go back before it finishes.
